reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed Support clusterLocal host exclusions for multi-cluster", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments using clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster deployments will now have correct behavior; previously this feature did not work as intended.
consequence.remediation: No action required; this is a bugfix that improves existing functionality.

proposed.statement: Support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster deployments was fixed in Istio 1.24.0.
